name: omnical/microsoft
description: Omnical's Microsoft Graph, under any PHP host: Outlook and Microsoft 365 calendars over OAuth 2.0 - the user's calendars, their events read (each occurrence of a series, or the series) and written, time zones kept (Windows names read back as IANA), recurrence as RRULE data both ways, attendees and their answers, a read-then-write check on changeKey against lost updates, busy time of people by their address (getSchedule) - with Microsoft's throttling limits declared and enforced.

suggest.ext-intl: Every Windows time zone name Graph sends read back as IANA (a table of the common ones otherwise)
